name: Datassist
_source: Palette and typography extracted programmatically from datassist.com.tr; logos downloaded from the site's media library. Swap this file and assets/ to retarget the pipeline at another brand.

fonts._note: Family names must match the TTF 'name' table exactly. A mismatch makes libass silently substitute a fallback font, which may lack ğ/ş/ı and render tofu boxes in a published clip. Verified at preflight.
fonts._brand_reference: The website uses Cabin + Open Sans (latin-ext). Those are web fonts; the shipped desktop equivalents above are glyph-verified for Turkish and avoid a runtime download in a no-touch pipeline.

logo._note: Top-right placement deliberately avoids TikTok/Reels UI chrome, which occupies the top-left and the bottom ~250px.

voice.persona: Bordro, ücret ve İK konularında veri odaklı, iddialı ama jargonsuz bir uzman sesi.
voice.audience: Türkiye'de İK yöneticileri, bordro uzmanları, KOBİ sahipleri ve ücret politikası karar vericileri.

_banned_note: Enforced programmatically in copy/validators.py. These are the phrases that make social copy read as templated filler rather than as something written from this specific clip.
